answer: Rule: one funding wallet registers identities on an exponential burn ladder. First identity burns 100 POA, second 200, third 400, doubling each time, so ten fakes burn 102,300 POA before earning a cent. The reef of cheap duplicates is priced out: honest operators pay once, attackers face a horizon of costs that doubles with every sibling. A zephyr of free signups becomes a storm of burned stake, and duplicates are rejected at registration, not after payout.
